title: 第24章 心里博弈，影帝上线
novel_title: 九恶妃每日一问，陛下驾崩了吗？
content_zh:
你配吗？

    龙雀语气中没有丝毫客气，有的仅是赤裸裸的不屑与嘲讽。

    秦然自然知晓这规矩，脸上表情没有丝毫变化。

    看着前方雄伟壮观，充斥着古朴气息的青铜大门，今日，他势必要进去走一遭……

    他转头看向龙雀，眼间忽然露出了几分慵懒之色。

    “爱妃说的没错，云家先祖们的确留下过这个规矩，不过朕想与你打个赌…有兴趣吗？”

    “赌什么？”龙雀睥睨道。

    “就赌…今日你先让朕进去，三天后，朕来接受圣人一击，如何？”

    龙雀冷着脸嗤笑出声。

    “做什么美梦！”

    “你是想找个由头溜进去，将宝物先拿走，三日之后，再随意找个理由搪塞本尊？”

    “你个区区通脉境的蝼蚁，别说给你三天时间，便是三年、三十年，你也不可能扛住圣人一击！”

    秦然笑了。

    忽然抬手，在掌心划出了一道血口子。

    瞬间，淡金色鲜血涌了出来。

    他指尖沾着鲜血，对着眼前空荡的空气书写起来。

    “子孙云江仙，以云族血脉立誓，先祖们为证！”

    “今日子孙先入始祖殿，三日后，再来此接受圣人一击！”

    “子孙若能侥幸抗住，不求好处！若受不住圣人一击，在日后凝聚出完整龙运之时，愿将龙运全部赠于龙雀！”

    “若违此誓，血肉凋零，永堕轮回！”

    嗡！！

    空气中荡起一串涟漪，秦然刚写下的字体凝聚成型，化作两道淡淡金光，嗖嗖地分别钻入了二人额头当中……

    龙雀不自觉地皱起了眉。

    她不可思议地盯着秦然，沉默数秒后，眼底浮现出一抹凝重之色。

    “倒是小觑了你。”

    “实力虽然不行，倒是略有几分胆色。”

    “云江仙，你的勇气可嘉，但此事于你来说难于登天，既然你愿主动献上大夏龙运，那本尊自然没有接受的道理。”

    “不过……”

    龙雀的语气一顿。

    秦然玩味调侃，“怎么，舍不得朕？”

    龙雀讥讽一笑。

    “做什么美梦！本尊岂会舍不得你个一无是处的废物，不对，你也不能算一无是处，起码你的脸蛋长得还不错……”

    “爱妃好眼光！”

    秦然主动凑到龙雀身边，想要去摸她的脸蛋，后者目光陡然一冷。

    凤眸中轰然爆发出两道恐怖圣焰！
content_en:
Do you deserve it?

    There was no politeness in Longque's tone, only naked disdain and ridicule.

    Qin Ran naturally knew this rule, and the expression on his face did not change at all.

    Looking at the majestic and ancient bronze gate ahead, he must go in and take a walk today...

    He turned to look at Long Que, his eyes suddenly showing a bit of laziness.

    "My concubine is right. The ancestors of the Yun family did leave behind this rule, but I want to make a bet with you... Are you interested?"

    "What are you betting on?" Long Que said scornfully.

    "Just bet...you let me in first today, and three days later, I will come to receive the Saint's blow. How about that?"

    Long Que sneered with a cold face.

    "What a sweet dream!"

    "Are you trying to find a way to sneak in, take the treasure away, and then, three days later, find any excuse to excuse me?"

    "You are just an ant in the Tongmai Realm. Let alone three days, even if you are given three or thirty years, you will not be able to withstand the Saint's attack!"

    Kieran smiled.

    Suddenly he raised his hand and made a bloody cut in his palm.

    Instantly, light golden blood poured out.

    His fingertips were stained with blood, and he started writing in the empty air in front of him.

    "My descendants, Immortal Yunjiang, swear an oath on the blood of the Yun clan, as witnessed by my ancestors!"

    "Today, my descendants will enter the Ancestral Hall first, and three days later, they will come here again to receive the Saint's blow!"

    "If my descendants are lucky enough to be able to withstand it, I won't ask for any benefits! If they can't withstand the saint's blow, when they gather a complete dragon's luck in the future, I am willing to give all the dragon's luck to the dragon bird!"

    "If you violate this oath, your flesh and blood will wither and you will fall into reincarnation forever!"

    Buzz! !

    A series of ripples rippled in the air, and the words Qin Ran had just written condensed and took shape, turning into two faint golden lights, which swished into the foreheads of the two of them...

    Longque frowned unconsciously.

    She stared at Qin Ran in disbelief. After a few seconds of silence, a solemn look appeared in her eyes.

    "I underestimated you."

    "Although his strength is not good, he does have a bit of courage."

    "Xian Yunjiang, your courage is commendable, but this matter is difficult for you to achieve. Since you are willing to offer the Great Xia Dragon Luck, I naturally have no reason to accept it."

    "But..."

    Long Que's tone paused.

    Qin Ran teased, "Why, you can't bear to leave me?"

    Long Que smiled sarcastically.

    "What a sweet dream! How could I not be willing to part with you, a worthless waste? No, you can't be considered worthless. At least you have a pretty face..."

    "My dear concubine, you have good eyesight!"

    Qin Ran took the initiative to approach Longque and wanted to touch her face, but the latter's eyes suddenly turned cold.

    Two terrifying holy flames burst out from the phoenix eyes!
title_en: Chapter 24 In the inner game, the movie king comes online
